notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 2024.8.21
notes.notes:
This update adds a new interactive TUTORIAL to guide you through the game mechanics to better prepare you for the challenges ahead!

The TUTORIAL will go over:

 Hardlight tower defense basics
 In-Game UI and the various functions
 Movement and camera controls
 Building ILLUMINATION and DAMAGE towers
 Basic tower actions
 The W.I.S.P. and its functions and abilities


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028605/cfbc150eae0b62ade07a64598d4587e8068a54ab.png

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 2024.8.8
notes.notes:
This small patch focuses on enemy balance with wave progression and fixes a small issue with projectiles.

ENHANCEMENTS
- Enhance enemy balance and scale for wave progression.

FIXES
- Fix issue with projectiles occasionally moving towards the wrong target.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 2024.7.29
notes.notes:
This patch includes updates to the balance and difficulty settings, adds a level to 2 towers and includes various enhancements and fixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028605/e9fe37f6dcf53e245543b864baf7bb3fa499dbad.png

ENHANCEMENTS
- Updated and enhanced balance for all enemies and scale of stats such as health and worth.
- Added a 4th level to the Rotospark and Novabolt towers.

FIXES
- Fixed ballistic projectiles occasionally traveling to the wrong target location.
- Fixed CORE attack VFX on Kalleto 4.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 2024.7.24
notes.notes:
This patch brings a few big changes to the WISP, adding two new actions:  SCOUT and SENTRY.
These will put the WISP into an automated mode to assist in illuminating enemies or defending the base!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028605/63d25270797b0d04a5e56600ef4ce7df003774da.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028605/8b0b71b7a6c8669bf3fbc38888f4ffd1cc41d0a4.png
The WISP will actively seek out enemies on the map and track them, illuminating the path they are on until they are destroyed or complete an attack on the base.   Targeting Priority: STRONG

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028605/f627a990aad9d502821426a0b107e88b479b369c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028605/025d0bfd31d938db4d832377822e69a0744af241.png
The WISP will move to the base and hover above it, attacking any enemies that enter the area surrounding it.   Targeting Priority: WEAK

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028605/692fe33e7867ffa8ec2508d627abe9f755326fe9.png

In a future update, the targeting priority for both SCOUT and SENTRY will be configurable.

In addition, we have added indicators to show the position of the WISP and enemy portals when they are off-screen.  For the portals, the indicator will change if they are open or closed.

ENHANCEMENTS
- Add SCOUT and SENTRY modes to the WISP
- Added offscreen indicators to the UI for the WISP and enemy portals (open and closed status will determine the image displayed).

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 2024.7.5
notes.notes:
This patch addresses some minor issues and enhancements made during Next Fest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028605/3d049424ccedecd9fc93cdd8d7424092206cd62b.png

ENHANCEMENTS
- Speed up camera transition when loading map.
- Set default button click audio for all buttons, menus, WISP actions, etc.  NOTE: These are placeholders and will be replaced with various SFX soon.
- Enhance keyboard navigation throughout all non-gameplay scenes.
- Update header text fade in/out delay to make it faster.
- If a menu item is selected that has a submenu, that submenu will now close.

FIXES
- Fix issue with keyboard navigation moving to areas behind a popped up window.
- Fix enemy death not resetting the initial explosion position each time.
- Fix text on the Tower Shop info popup being the wrong font/size on certain maps.
- Fix for Main Menu and Map Select sometimes both being active when returning from playing a map.
- Fix UI issues when transitioning to Map Select after opening and closing a popup.
- Fix transition sound playing and music restart when going to the System from Map Select.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 2024.6.12.1
notes.notes:
This patch addresses some minor issues and enhancements made during Next Fest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028605/3d049424ccedecd9fc93cdd8d7424092206cd62b.png

ENHANCEMENTS
- Reduced fade-in/fade-out times to speed up wait time between scene loads.
- Add currency icon to tower shop menu items.
- Add Tactical UI with info box explaining Intensity.
- Update Tutorial page menu buttons for consistency.
- Update Tutorial page content to make things easier to understand and added explanation of INTENSITY.
- Update Tutorial UI to explain INTENSITY.

FIXES
- Minor text descriptions and grammar fixes for popups.
- Disable shop menu when the player is in Tactical view.
- Update sound management to prevent volume increase when playing multiple sounds simultaneously.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 2024.6.10
notes.notes:
This is a minor patch to address an issue with the Feedback Form which may have been preventing some feedback reaching us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028605/e8b38cb05cc434f79b7bc8d6c22df03c7e3714ca.png

FIXES
- Fix Feedback Form request issue

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 2024.6.9
notes.notes:
This is the final update before going live for Next Fest June 2024!  Some final tweaks to balance based on feedback from our amazing and supportive community and friends!

Thank you all for helping us to make the Hardlight Demo even better!

Please watch our live streams during Next Fest (from our Steam Page):

Tuesday June 11 @ 5 PM EST
Thursday June 13 @ 6 PM EST

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028605/e8b38cb05cc434f79b7bc8d6c22df03c7e3714ca.png
ENHANCEMENTS
- Update Achievement descriptions for Photic Sweep and Conductive Surge.
- Update Ability cooldowns for better balance.

FIXES
- Fix timing of credit checks when a shop menu is active.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 2024.6.8
notes.notes:
After some more feedback, we've added the ability to decrease the game speed as well as increase, by right-clicking on the speed icon or pressing "Y" on the keyboard.  Also, the controls in Settings now display more binding information.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028605/e8b38cb05cc434f79b7bc8d6c22df03c7e3714ca.png

ENHANCEMENTS
- Add ability to decrease game speed by right-clicking icon or pressing "Y".

FIXES
- Update Controls on Settings to reflect all the controls.
- Add audio info to summary of full game

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 2024.6.5
notes.notes:
So for those of you following our updates on Steam, we paused posting Path Notes while we made major changes to the UI, gameplay, lore and everything in between.  Hardlight development has been progressing very well and will be a part of Steam Next Fest (June 10-17) which we are all very excited for.  In preparation, we have a Hardlight Demo that has been going through some testing and will be made public within the next few days.  We hope anyone who plays it enjoys the game!

With that announcement out of the way, based on some feedback from our early access demo players, we have pushed out some updates and will be continuing to do so as we receive more feedback from players.  Thank you to everyone who has helped us improve the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028605/e8b38cb05cc434f79b7bc8d6c22df03c7e3714ca.png

ENHANCEMENTS
- Updated Map layouts, wave definitions and difficulty settings to make the maps included in the demo challenging and enjoyable (hopefully).
- Adjusted XP required for levelling up during the early player levels.
- Reduced time for destroyed enemies to disappear.
- Moved "How to Play" from Map Select to Main Menu and change arrow to a close icon.
- Updated "back" icons to match existing style and make the arrow look more like an arrow.
- Updated Map History default text to point out victories are needed for tracking history.
- Updated base attack alert disappear sooner and added a button that moves the camera to the base.

FIXES
- Moved terrain away to prevent overlapping on the area around the base on the first map of Kalleto.
- Fixed Feedback From response text so it doesn't appear beneath the buttons.
- Disabled clicking of placement tile while tower is under attack which was leaving a ghost if the tower was destroyed.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Alpha Build 0.7
notes.notes:
This build is focused on enhancing the Torchblade tower to improve it's targeting, enemy impacts, and make it easier to visualize the damage area while it's attacking.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44028605/d2e16d7090f208f7f78d932f7caaaa1e4d520c66.gif

ENHANCEMENTS
- Updated VFX for Torchblade to enhance visibility and better indicate the sweep range and power of the energy blade
- Adjusted the Torchblade collider used to detect which enemies are in range to make it more accurate
FIXES
- Fixed issue where a Level 3 Torchblade tower would rotate in the wrong direction when returning to its idle position after firing

notes.title: Patch Notes: Alpha Build 0.6
notes.notes:
This build contains various improvements to tower targeting and damage, which particular focus on the Plasma and Disc towers.  Damage should be better and more consistent, and hopefully a lot more satisfying.

ENHANCEMENTS
- Instantiated hit objects, such as the Plasma splat, now take advantage of pooling which should improve performance slightly.
- Updated VFX for Plasma splat for better rendering visibility.
- Enhanced damage audio SFX for Plasma splat to reduce amount of times it is played.
- Added positional data to SFX for Plasma impact and splat damage so they are accurately placed when spatial audio is on.
- Adjusted Disc projectile speeds at all levels for consistency.

FIXES
- Damage calculations should accurately be calculated based on Intensity.
- Arcing projectiles should now properly detonate/impact if the target enemy is destroyed before they reach their target.
- Projectile target locations on enemies should be more accurate to the body of the enemy and not above or below.
- Various projectile performance tweaks and fixes.
- Projectiles in-flight will no longer damage enemies that are not illuminated.
- Towers will stop firing at enemies that de-illuminate during the firing process.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Alpha Build 0.5
notes.notes:
A few quality and visual enhancements are included in this patch, along with some currency and intensity scaling fixes.  Translation:  We screwed up some math but it's all better now.

ENHANCEMENTS
- Updated rendering settings for multiple levels of quality, ensuring visual effects for illumination work on more platforms.
FIXES
- Previously-saved audio settings are now applied correctly when game is first loaded
- Towers can now be built/upgraded if the total credits is equal to the cost to build/upgrade.
- Amount of credits subtracted from the total now matches the displayed cost in the build/upgrade menu.
- Tower destruction VFX will no longer affect the scale of enemies
- Path illumination VFX will no longer distort enemies walking on them.
- Enemy damage will now properly scale with Intensity.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Alpha Build 0.4
notes.notes:
This patch addresses a few issues that were brought to our attention by our alpha testers, particularly focusing on the Portal and Pulse Shield abilities, along with some related fixes and enhancements.

FEATURES
- Added range indicator for Portal ability to display range from "in" portal location to "out" portal.
ENHANCEMENTS
- Updated Pulse Shield timer to extend the attack timer if the tower selected is under attack.
- Increased Pulse Shield cooldown from 10s to 45s.
- Enemies attacking are immune to Portals teleportation.
FIXES
- Fixed Pulse Shield occasionally causing enemies to get "stuck" in a stunned state at spawn points.
- Pulse Shield will now be destroyed if the tower it is attached to is destroyed.
- Fixed Portal not properly activating when clicking on paths.  Portal should work properly now.
- Portals will now despawn at game end.
- Prevent teleportation of enemies until the "out" portal has been placed.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Alpha Build 0.3
notes.notes:
Alpha Build 0.3 has been pushed out to our Alpha testers and comes with numerous fixes and enhancements, particularly to how the end of the level is handled.  A tutorial has been added to the Level Select screen which should help with onboarding our newest Alpha testers and, in addition, there is a new setting for automated error reporting which is turned off by default but can be enabled by going to Home > Settings > Game and checking the box next to "Error Reporting".

We hope to continue improving the game and squishing these early bugs.  We thank all of our Alpha testers for their help with this.  It means a lot to us.

FEATURES
- Added camera zoom when player loads into a game level and zoom out when returning to orbit from Pause screen.
- Added event subscription to cameras
- Added tutorial which can be viewed by clicking the "?" icon on the Level Select screen.
- Added option for automated Error Reporting.  It can be changed by going to Home > Settings > Game and checking the "Error Reporting" box.  It's disabled by default.  Error Reporting will automatically submit an error report if one occurs during gameplay.  Hopefully, this will help us more quickly and efficiently get fixes into new builds.

ENHANCEMENTS
- Enhanced options for waves to better incorporate dropped spawn points and updated waves configurations to utilize this.
- Added delay to dropped portal to delay despawning until after closing animation has completed.
- Enhanced delay for victory and defeat to better view the action before the UI is displayed and sped up victory delay.
- After Focus Fire completed, the WISP will attempt to return to the closest path from the enemy it was targeting, which should result in more natural transitions to a path.
- Increased Plasma Bomb ability cooldown from 10s to 35s.
- Increased Focus Fire ability cooldown from 10s to 25s.
- Updated camera shake for Plasma Bomb and Wall of Light with more appropriate settings.
- Updated Plasma splat lifetime for all 3 levels as well increased coverage radius.
- Enemies will now stop walking animation and movement when the level is over.
- Updated pathing to keep enemies closer to the middle of the patch, particularly around corners.

FIXES
- Fixed issue where star backdrops on home scene were not correctly appearing when returning from a game level.
- Fixed rendering issue with background terrain
- Fixed light position in home scene (solar system).
- Fixed errors that could occur during wave spawning which was preventing the level from finishing.
- Fixed an issue causing dropped portals to stay open and not despawn.
- Fixed paths not being disabled properly when a portal/spawner is dropped on them.
- Fixed scale of dropped objects not being reset if the enemy carrying them had changed scale.
- Fixed wave enemy calculations for number of waves successfully defended/completed.
- Fixed mislabeled "waves" as "rounds" on defeat screen.
- Fixed issues with checking for final enemy of the level not properly getting triggered, resulting in camera transitions not happening consistently.
- Fixed game speed issue by forcing a game speed reset before victory/defeat transitions.
- Fixed Plasma Bomb not resetting the UI after being used.
- Fixed Focus Fire not illuminating an enemy for its entire duration.
- Fixed Focus Fire modified damage calculation which was causing values much higher than intended.
- Fixed Focus Fire rotation so the WISP returns to the proper location after use.
- Fixed camera shake not being implemented properly and causing errors if it occurred after end of game transition had begun.
- Fixed layer for destroyed enemies to prevent unintended interaction with moving enemies.
- Fixed layer interaction for Plasma Tower splat prevent unintended interaction with moving enemies.
- Fixed enemy scale change when attacking to only affect the model and not the health bar/damage popup.
- Fixed issue with shards not being cleared occasionally when enemies are spawned.
- Minor updates to stop background processes when the end of the level occurs.

REMOVED
- Removed camera blur as it causes strangeness to the UI elements and transparent objects.
